hyps.why: Replacing a parameter-free pooling on the final edge with a 3x3 conv gives large gains on all datasets.
Swapping avg_pool for a conv on edge 5 consistently improves accuracy.
Replacing pooling on the input edge with a conv yields large gains, up to about +10 points.
Replacing pooling on edge 1 with a 3x3 conv is positive on all datasets in most cases.
With edge 4 absent, removing edge 3 cuts a main path into the output, causing a very large drop.
With only a weak skip on edge 3, removing edge 5 leaves the output starved of learned features, causing a large drop.
Replacing a 3x3 conv on the input edge with a skip loses capacity.
Removing a 3x3 conv edge loses capacity consistently.
Downgrading the final-edge 3x3 conv to a skip hurts, especially on C100 and ImageNet16-120.
Replacing a 3x3 conv on edge 2 with a skip mostly reduces accuracy.
